# Command-line reference

<!-- Generated by `slopvac cli-reference`. Do not edit. -->

## `slopvac`

Lint prose for AI-generated text patterns.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--offline` | Never use the network. SLOPVAC_OFFLINE=1 and `[network] offline = true` do the same, and nothing turns it off. |
| `--color` | Colour output. NO_COLOR is honoured. |
| `--no-color` | Alias for --color never. |

### `slopvac lint`

Lint prose and source comments. Bare paths run this command.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<TARGETS>` | Files or directories to lint. |
| `--stdin` | Lint one document from standard input. |
| `--language` | Name the parser for standard input. |
| `--mode` | Input surface. |
| `--config` | Use this slopvac.toml instead of the nearest one. |
| `--category` | Run only these categories. Repeatable. |
| `--disable` | Disable a category or a qualified rule ID. Repeatable. |
| `--format` | Report format. |
| `--out` | Write the report here instead of standard output. |
| `--open` | Open the HTML report in a browser. |
| `--min-score` | Fail below this 0-100 score. |
| `--max-per-100-words` | Fail above this severity-weighted density. |
| `--locale` | Spelling target: en-US, en-GB, or und to disable. |
| `--diff-base` | Scope findings to lines added in REV...HEAD. |
| `--diff-working-tree` | Scope findings to staged, unstaged and untracked changes. |
| `--fix` | Apply safe replacements. |
| `--verbose` | Show categories with no findings. |
| `--explain-config` | Print each resolved setting with its source, then exit. |
| `--offline` | Never use the network. SLOPVAC_OFFLINE=1 and `[network] offline = true` do the same, and nothing turns it off. |
| `--color` | Colour output. NO_COLOR is honoured. |
| `--no-color` | Alias for --color never. |

### `slopvac rules`

List rules.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--category` | Only this category. Repeatable. |
| `--kind` | Only this match kind. |
| `--genre` | Only rules in categories recommended for this genre. |
| `--include-excluded` | With --genre, keep rules whose applies_to excludes the genre. |
| `--format` | Output format. |
| `--config` | Use this slopvac.toml instead of the nearest one. |
| `--offline` | Never use the network. SLOPVAC_OFFLINE=1 and `[network] offline = true` do the same, and nothing turns it off. |
| `--color` | Colour output. NO_COLOR is honoured. |
| `--no-color` | Alias for --color never. |

### `slopvac init`

Write a commented slopvac.toml and set up agent steering.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--force` | Overwrite an existing config file. |
| `--path` | Config file to write. |
| `--skip-agents` | Write the config only: no steering block and no skill. |
| `--harness` | Set up steering for this harness. Repeatable. Default: agents. |
| `--no-skills` | Write the steering blocks but no slopvac-prose skill. |
| `--offline` | Never use the network. SLOPVAC_OFFLINE=1 and `[network] offline = true` do the same, and nothing turns it off. |
| `--color` | Colour output. NO_COLOR is honoured. |
| `--no-color` | Alias for --color never. |

### `slopvac setup`

Install or remove project-local steering for a harness

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<HARNESS>` | Required unless --list is used |
| `--list` | List supported harnesses |
| `--remove` | Remove the managed block, skill and reviewer agent |
| `--check` | Report whether the managed files are current without changing them |
| `--root` | Project directory that holds the steering files |
| `--block` | Size of the steering block |
| `--no-skill` | Install no slopvac-prose skill |
| `--agent` | Install the reviewer agent file, which runs only when `slopvac prime review` calls it |
| `--reviewer-model` | Model for the reviewer agent; it must differ from the author's model |
| `--offline` | Never use the network. SLOPVAC_OFFLINE=1 and `[network] offline = true` do the same, and nothing turns it off. |
| `--color` | Colour output. NO_COLOR is honoured. |
| `--no-color` | Alias for --color never. |

### `slopvac prime`

Print guidance for agents, one topic at a time

| --- | --- |

### `slopvac review`

Plan or run the review of a revision

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<REVISED>` | The revised document |
| `--original` | The document before the revision |
| `--type` | Review type; auto picks from the change |
| `--genre` | The document's genre |
| `--extra` | Checks to add beyond the changed claims |
| `--scope-approved` | The user confirmed the scope |
| `--reviewer-model` | Model that reviews; it must differ from the author's |
| `--author-model` | Model that wrote the revision; overrides [review] author_model |
| `--dry-run` | Print the exact payload and call no provider |
| `--offline` | Never use the network. SLOPVAC_OFFLINE=1 and `[network] offline = true` do the same, and nothing turns it off. |
| `--color` | Colour output. NO_COLOR is honoured. |
| `--no-color` | Alias for --color never. |
